newsitem.title: GERMANY: Summary of Ifo July German business survey.
newsitem.headline: Summary of Ifo July German business survey.

text.p: Following is a summary of key points in the IFO economic research institute's monthly business survey for July (sectors are west German unless otherwise stated, comparisons are against pvs month):
Ifo last week said its business climate index showed a rise to 94.1 in July from 90.4 in June.
Orders levels - clearly better (first time since beginning of 1995)
Note - Chemical industry confident on exports, metals said demand was higher but not for exports, paper said orders rose.
Current business - clearly better (first time since Sept 1995)
Note - engineering sector reported stabilisation of demand, electro-technical goods makers saw better export prospects and higher demand. Truck makers said business not as bad as in previous months.
Note - Car makers reported rising orders and satisfactory business. Electro-technical consumer goods sector were more sceptical about future prospects.
Note - Clothing sector said situation worse while shoe sector said business outlook was better.
Current business - hardly less unfavourable (equipment capacity utilisation static at 58 pct but down from 61 pct in July 1995)
Orders level - 2.6 months vs 2.8 in June 1995
Current business - clearly better, but 1/4 of firms still say business unsatisfactory
Current business - improved to near satisfactory
Personnel plans - 1 pct reduction in next three months.
